data.gender_notes: Fahyim is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'fahaha' meaning 'to be exalted or lifted up', Fahyim is a noble, elevated name for a boy in Islamic tradition. It is a name that signifies dignity, honor, and respect. The name Fahyim carries the meaning “Exalted, noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fahyim usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fahyim total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
